category: Actual shared navigation and CSS, isolated React19 page guard fixture
contract: Shared native capture dismissal registers in ancestor layout effect; page guards register in descendant passive effects. Page guards remain responsible for cancellation, state, recovery, and focus.
limitation: Externally preinstalled or descendant layout-effect guards may run before dismissal and attempt focus while native dialog content outside is inert. That unsupported ordering diagnostic is preserved in preinstalled-guard-order-report.json.
